Sandbox_AlwaysLogErrors_tooltip: Grava avisos e marcos de carregamento no arquivo de log de depuração do LasciviousFactionsSystem mesmo com o Log de depuração desligado, para que um problema real deixe rastro sem precisar ativar o log detalhado com antecedência. O Log de depuração ainda controla o log completo e detalhado.
Sandbox_BaseClaimTiles_tooltip: Quadrados que uma facção pode reivindicar antes do bônus de pontuação ser somado. Uma base 20x20 são 400 quadrados.
Sandbox_ClaimDecayDays_tooltip: Dissolve uma facção (liberando seu terreno reivindicado) após esta quantidade de dias REAIS sem nenhum de seus membros conectados. Medido pelo relógio real, então avança mesmo com o servidor desligado. 0 desativa o decaimento.
Sandbox_Debug_tooltip: Imprime logs [LFS] detalhados no console para investigar problemas (territórios, reposicionamento de renascimento, sincronização de casa segura).
Sandbox_HKAutoOpenOnSpawnEnabled_tooltip: Automatically opens the /kit panel about 2 seconds after a new character is created, so players who don't read chat or don't know the command still see it.
Sandbox_HKInitialAmmoBoxesMax_tooltip: Maximum ammo boxes granted when a firearm is won.
Sandbox_HKInitialAmmoBoxesMin_tooltip: Minimum ammo boxes granted when a firearm is won.
Sandbox_HKInitialDrinkQuantityMax_toolti: Maximum amount rolled for the drink slot.
Sandbox_HKInitialDrinkQuantityMin_toolti: Minimum amount rolled for the drink slot.
Sandbox_HKInitialFirearmChance_tooltip: Independent chance of also winning a firearm and matching ammo.
Sandbox_HKInitialFoodQuantityMax_tooltip: Maximum amount rolled for the food slot.
Sandbox_HKInitialFoodQuantityMin_tooltip: Minimum amount rolled for the food slot.
Sandbox_HKInitialKitCooldownEnabled_tool: When on, the same account must wait the cooldown below before claiming another Initial Kit on a new character. Off by default. This is real-world time on purpose, not in-game time -- it exists to stop create-character/claim/die/repeat farming, which in-game time couldn't prevent.
Sandbox_HKInitialKitCooldownHours_toolti: How many real hours must pass on the same account before another Initial Kit can be claimed (anti-abuse across character deaths).
Sandbox_HKInitialKitEnabled_tooltip: Turns the whole Initial Kit system on or off.
Sandbox_HKInitialKitSingleUseEnabled_too: When enabled, each account can consume the Initial Kit only once from this point forward. Claims made in this mode are not released by death, new characters or cooldown. Off by default.
Sandbox_HKInitialMeleeHighDamageOnly_too: When on, the Initial Kit's melee roll only picks weapons with real damage (script MaxDamage) at or above the threshold below. Off by default.
Sandbox_HKInitialMeleeMinDamage_tooltip: Damage threshold used by 'High-end melee only' above. For reference: the Katana's real MaxDamage is 8.0 (the single hardest-hitting melee weapon in the pool); the default of 2.0 captures a balanced ~36-item upper tier (sledgehammers, machetes, swords, axes, and more) out of the full ~137-item pool, without narrowing it down to just the Katana.
Sandbox_HKInitialResourceQuantityMax_too: Maximum amount rolled for the resource/tool slot.
Sandbox_HKInitialResourceQuantityMin_too: Minimum amount rolled for the resource/tool slot (flashlight, first aid supplies, etc).
Sandbox_HKInitialSkillGroupCountMax_tool: Maximum number of different skill classes that may receive a bonus in the Initial Kit. There are 6 classes; with both minimum and maximum set to 6, every class receives a random bonus.
Sandbox_HKInitialSkillGroupCountMin_tool: Minimum number of different skill classes that receive a bonus in the Initial Kit. While the system is enabled, this is never lower than 1.
Sandbox_HKMeleeHeavyWeightThreshold_tool: Minimum real item weight for a melee weapon to be considered heavy and receive the reduced roll weight below. The comparison is inclusive: at 3.0, every weapon with Weight 3.0 or higher is heavy. Applies to both the Initial Kit and Survival Reward.
Sandbox_HKSidebarButtonEnabled_tooltip: Adds a Hardcore Kits icon button to the left sidebar (next to Inventory, Health, Map, etc) to open /kit without the chat -- especially useful in singleplayer, which has no real player chat. Only shown when there's something to claim (Initial Kit or Survival Reward available).
Sandbox_HKSurvivalMaximumStoredRewards_t: Caps how many unclaimed rewards can pile up if the player doesn't claim on time. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_HKSurvivalRewardIntervalDays_too: How many full in-game days a character must survive per reward earned.
Sandbox_LSCreditsPerHourSurvived_tooltip: Credits granted for each completed hour added to the native survival counter. Changes affect future earnings; unregistered characters receive their current-life history at this rate.
Sandbox_LSCreditsPerZombieKill_tooltip: Credits granted for each increase in the native zombie-kill counter. Changes affect future earnings; unregistered characters receive their current-life history at this rate.
Sandbox_LSDebugAddCredits_tooltip: Grants 10,000 credits once per life while enabled. Existing characters also receive the grant when this option is enabled. Use only for shop testing.
Sandbox_LSKillCreditStealPercent_tooltip: When one player kills another, the killer receives this percentage of the victim's credit balance. 0 disables it entirely (default); 100 transfers the whole balance. Only counts a weapon hit from another PLAYER within the time window configured below -- an old wound followed by dying of hunger, thirst etc. days later never pays out.
Sandbox_LSPreserveCreditsOnDeath_tooltip: When enabled, dying does not reset the shop balance. If death is caused by another player and credit steal is configured, the stolen percentage is still deducted from the victim before preserving the remainder. Off by default.
Sandbox_LSOfferDiscountMaxPercent_toolti: Highest whole-number discount that can be rolled for a product.
Sandbox_LSOfferDiscountMinPercent_toolti: Lowest whole-number discount that can be rolled for a product.
Sandbox_LSOfferProductCountMax_tooltip: Maximum number of distinct products selected each rotation.
Sandbox_LSOfferProductCountMin_tooltip: Minimum number of distinct products selected each rotation.
Sandbox_LSOfferRotationRealMinutes_toolt: Real-time duration between rotations. Default is 60 minutes. Time continues while the server is offline.
Sandbox_LSOffersEnabled_tooltip: Enables server-wide offers. Every player sees the same products and discounts.
Sandbox_LSPriceMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies every base price before discounts while category multipliers are disabled.
Sandbox_MaxClaimTiles_tooltip: Teto absoluto de quadrados reivindicados por qualquer facção, independente da pontuação.
Sandbox_MinFactionSizeToClaim_tooltip: Número mínimo de membros que uma facção precisa ter antes de poder reivindicar terreno. O padrão 1 permite que uma facção de um único jogador reivindique.
Sandbox_MinPersonalScoreToCreateFaction: Pontuação pessoal mínima para criar facção
Sandbox_MinPersonalScoreToCreateFaction_: Pontuação mínima que o personagem atual do fundador precisa ter para criar uma facção. Usa os pontos de zumbis mortos + horas sobrevividas e não afeta facções que já existem. 0 permite criar sem pontos, ideal para testes.
Sandbox_OfflineRaidProtection: Proteção contra ataques sem defensores conectados
Sandbox_OfflineRaidProtection_tooltip: Quando ativado, uma facção não pode ser invadida a menos que pelo menos um dos seus membros esteja conectado para defender.
Sandbox_PactsEnabled_tooltip: Permite que dois donos de facção combinem um pacto mútuo de não-agressão (um propõe, o outro aceita). Enquanto ativo, nenhum dos dois pode declarar guerra ou invadir o outro. Qualquer um dos lados pode quebrar o pacto a qualquer momento.
Sandbox_PointsPerClaimArea_tooltip: Toda facção começa podendo manter 1 área. A cada bloco completo desta quantidade de pontos da facção, ela libera +1 área separada. O padrão 2500 libera a segunda área aos 2500 pontos, a terceira aos 5000 e assim por diante. Se a pontuação cair, áreas antigas permanecem, mas novas áreas ficam bloqueadas.
Sandbox_PointsPerHourSurvived_tooltip: Points for each survived hour recorded by the current character's native counter. Existing characters import their current-life survived time; offline players keep the last observed value. By default, the individual hour and zombie-kill totals reset when the character dies; the preserve-power option keeps the contribution already made.
Sandbox_PreserveMemberPowerOnDeath_toolt: When enabled, a member's death does not remove the zombie-kill and survived-hour points already contributed to the faction. The new life's native counter starts from 0 and keeps adding on top of the preserved total. Off by default.
Sandbox_PointsPerZombieKill_tooltip: Points from the current character of a MEMBER for each zombie kill. LFS reads the complete native character total, including history from before the mod was installed, and keeps the last observed value while the player is offline. By default, this individual score resets when the character dies; the preserve-power option keeps the contribution already made. Faction score is the sum of current members and defines the limit for new expansions; existing territories do not shrink when it drops.
Sandbox_RaidsEnabled_tooltip: Permite que facções invadam o território umas das outras. Um ataque é vencido superando em número os defensores dentro do território e segurando essa vantagem; um território capturado é queimado (perde o território e a proteção de saque), liberando o terreno.
Sandbox_TilesPerScorePoint: Quadrados extras por ponto de pontuação
Sandbox_TilesPerScorePoint_tooltip: Quadrados adicionais concedidos por ponto da facção (a soma dos personagens atuais dos membros). Se a pontuação cair, áreas existentes permanecem, mas novas expansões ficam bloqueadas enquanto a facção estiver acima do limite.
Sandbox_WarsEnabled_tooltip: Donos podem declarar guerra formal contra outra facção. A pontuação de guerra acumula com ataques vencidos e mortes contra o inimigo; o lado que atingir o alvo primeiro vence, as relações voltam a neutro, e um cessar-fogo bloqueia uma nova declaração por um tempo.
